Class UnitTest

java.lang.Object
models.base.UnitTest
class UnitTest extends Object
Tests for Unit base class logic — no JavaFX rendering involved. ConcreteUnit's update() delegates to updateAnimation() so we can drive the animation state machine through the same entry point Main uses.
